cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a bucket under the seascape like yours. Tide arranged. Hold it there; I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's for washing brushes. Why is the painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brushes sorted. You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's full. There's a tank at reception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch that. I'll hold this one until you're back.
